Callout.Name: Fight - Sandy Shores
Callout.Message: Fight outside a bar in Sandy Shores.
Callout.Advisory: Four involved, two on the ground.

Script.Line: It is four of them and it has spread out into the street.
They have all known each other twenty years. That does not help.
One is on the ground and I have not seen him move.

Lines.Approach: Four of them and two already on the floor. It is a small town and they all know each other.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
